applicability.notes: Pocket boundary v1 passed the repository grade-C analytic geometry contract and deterministic scan. Throat widths, jaw radius, capture depth, rebound material response, and real-world pot success remain experimentally unvalidated.

ball.friction_coefficient.evidence: Full-precision deterministic billiard-material fit from committed low-angle CALIBRATION groups only
ball.friction_coefficient.limitation: The source used a PVC laboratory bench and nominal 57.2 mm billiard balls; transfer to Chinese Pool cloth and 57.15 mm balls is not yet confirmed

ball.inertia_factor.evidence: Uniform solid-sphere rigid-body model I = 2/5 mR^2 used by the independently tested contact solver

ball.mass_kg.evidence: Chinese Pool production compatibility value retained from the frozen surface-motion profile

ball.normal_restitution.evidence: Full-precision deterministic billiard-material fit from committed low-angle CALIBRATION groups only
ball.normal_restitution.limitation: The source used a PVC laboratory bench and nominal 57.2 mm billiard balls; transfer to Chinese Pool cloth and 57.15 mm balls is not yet confirmed

ball.radius_cm.evidence: Chinese Pool production ball diameter of 5.715 cm

cue.chalked_friction_coefficient.evidence: Preregistered Coulomb-cone hypothesis used by the analytic contract; not fitted to Cross 2023 experimental markers

cue.cue_speed_per_power_unit_cm_s.evidence: Compatibility mapping chosen to preserve the center-hit production speed scale after introducing cue effective mass

cue.effective_mass_kg.evidence: Versioned legacy cue-mass compatibility value; independent mechanical measurement remains unavailable

cue.maximum_reliable_offset_radius.evidence: Preregistered operational miscue boundary for the analytic candidate; not experimentally validated

cue.normal_restitution.evidence: Inelastic compatibility hypothesis for the single rigid cue impulse; analytic energy nonincrease is checked independently

cue.unchalked_friction_coefficient.evidence: Preregistered lower-friction hypothesis used to distinguish unchalked slip; not fitted to experimental markers

cushion.friction_coefficient.evidence: Source-reported sensitivity center retained because perpendicular zero-sidespin experimental markers cannot identify horizontal rail friction
cushion.friction_coefficient.limitation: Requires oblique synchronized translation/spin experiments and Chinese Pool equipment confirmation

cushion.normal_restitution.evidence: Full-precision bounded least-squares fit from incident_low CALIBRATION markers only
cushion.normal_restitution.limitation: Constant restitution cannot represent speed-dependent cushion deformation and is transferred from snooker equipment

solver.maximum_events_per_tick.evidence: Deterministic solver safety bound retained from the governed surface-motion profile

solver.time_step_seconds.evidence: Existing deterministic automation and reference trace cadence

surface.legacy_friction_acceleration_cm_.evidence: Compatibility-only value retained from the frozen surface-motion profile

surface.rolling_resistance_acceleration_.evidence: Unchanged midpoint of the admitted Mathavan rolling-deceleration calibration interval from surface-motion v1

surface.sliding_friction_coefficient.evidence: Unchanged preregistered physical prior from the frozen surface-motion candidate

surface.slip_speed_epsilon_cm_s.evidence: Numerical classification epsilon retained from the governed surface-motion profile

surface.stop_energy_threshold_j.evidence: Numerical stopping threshold retained from the governed surface-motion profile

surface.torsional_spin_deceleration_rad_.limitation: No admitted sidespin-decay experiment is available

table_boundary.capture_depth_cm.evidence: Grade-C irreversible capture plane; direct measurement remains unavailable

table_boundary.corner_mouth_width_cm.evidence: Chinese Pool nominal corner pocket mouth width

table_boundary.corner_throat_width_cm.evidence: Grade-C analytic candidate throat width; direct measurement remains unavailable

table_boundary.jaw_radius_cm.evidence: Grade-C analytic candidate jaw radius; direct measurement remains unavailable

table_boundary.side_mouth_width_cm.evidence: Chinese Pool nominal side pocket mouth width

table_boundary.side_throat_width_cm.evidence: Grade-C analytic candidate throat width; direct measurement remains unavailable

table_boundary.throat_depth_cm.evidence: Grade-C analytic event-order boundary; direct measurement remains unavailable
